scope: Source-adapted core methods package, not the complete manuscript analysis archive
hash_policy: All source_sha256 values below identify source-code files only. No study input, participant record, outcome, or image hashes are included.
path_policy: Source paths are relative historical source filenames for attribution; these files are not runtime dependencies of this package.

adaptations: Retained listed definitions without numerical changes; removed unused SAGA imports.
fit_logistic delegates explicitly to the final deterministic corrected_fit implementation.
Original run_nested orchestration is replaced by a new explicit data-in/memory-out run_nested_models interface.
Public run_nested_models requires aligned unique nonempty string indices before fitting, avoiding implicit identifier coercion in training-isolation checks.
paper_settings supplies parameter-only defaults; no cohort rows, exclusions, outcomes, or private configuration access.
Synthetic fixture default size is 60; the fixture contains no real observations.

retained_functions: complete deterministic elastic-net solver module, including fit and independent_slsqp
adaptations: Source code preserved byte-for-byte; no data access or solver substitution.
Only pure fitting functions are retained; original paths, import-time private configuration reads, module monkeypatching, and filesystem orchestration are omitted.
Package-relative imports replace private source loaders.
Failure-only diagnostic candidate counts derive from the supplied grid and inner-fold count instead of fixed counts; successful numerical path is unchanged.
Public high-level orchestration stops on a failed fit and does not return incomplete prediction summaries.

retained_functions: fit numerical expressions, exposed as hc3_fit
adaptations: QR OLS, HC3 sandwich covariance, residual degrees-of-freedom inference, and independent SVD checks are preserved.
Explicit finite/full-rank input checks replace private runtime globals; independent diagnostics are returned in memory.
association_family is a new explicit six-region interface with caller-supplied covariates and declared complete multiplicity family size.

retained_functions: bh algorithm and independent sorted-p reverse-cumulative-minimum verification
adaptations: bh_adjust accepts a complete p-value vector and explicit expected_tests instead of mutating private study records.
Private association, ablation, cohort, and output-file orchestration is not included.

retained_functions: primary node and six-composite calculations from extract_subject
adaptations: Explicit array/aligned-NIfTI interfaces replace subject-path lookup and private cohort records.
Public extraction is restricted to primary nodes and composites; non-primary atlas and ancillary nodes are omitted.
Small feature-definition mappings are adapted from the original algorithm specifications without participant-specific gates.

retained_functions: six T1 feature calculations from extract_subject
adaptations: Callers supply statistics or explicit statistics-file paths; no private eligibility ledger or subject directory inference.
Public wrappers add explicit input validation and omit private cohort-specific QC and filesystem output routines.

retained_functions: normalization-mask and reference-mean expressions within process
adaptations: normalization_masks and normalize_pet expose the three reference branches and float32 normalized-image calculation without registration or image-writing orchestration.
Original image-level QC rules are documented separately from synthetic fixtures.
Documentation-only source for accepted-transform/resampling context; executable preprocessing runner is not published here.
Documentation-only context for controlled T1 feature/QC provenance; private ledger and cohort-role functions are not published.

checks: Full solver AST equality and retained core-definition AST equality against original source.
One synthetic CP outer fold using all 30 hyperparameter candidates and three inner folds: original and public probabilities and saved fit information exactly equal (91 fit records).
HC3 original return arrays and scalar degrees of freedom exactly equal on synthetic data.
PET six composites in three reference branches, all 19 primary-node summaries, and six T1 features exactly equal AST-selected source-function outputs on synthetic inputs.
Feature-definition subsets checked against original parameter specifications; PET normalization expressions source-reviewed.

Public unittests cover deterministic fitting, training-only preprocessing, shared split coverage, held-out label isolation, synthetic C/CP/CPT smoke fitting, string-index rejection, HC3/BH, complete 6/18-test association families, feature arrays and synthetic file interfaces.
limitations: These tests do not reproduce real-cohort estimates or verify the complete manuscript pipeline.
The full-grid source comparison covers one synthetic CP outer fold, not all repeated folds or all supplementary routes.
No full DICOM preprocessing, segmentation, registration, PVC, PetPrep, or manuscript figure rendering was executed.
